verdicts.reason: Both 320x50 banners drop the product can and squeeze the tagline into an unreadable, word-per-line column at the far right. Their oversized CTA pill also competes with the headline. A also drops the SOLSTICE logo completely, so the brand is lost. B keeps a tiny logo above the headline, but it is jammed against 'Chase the Light' and the NEW FLAVOR badge, which makes the left cluster cramped.
